Add makes DIR a root. Nothing is read until agent index crawl.
--depth sets how deep its projects go: full (dirs, files, symbols,
sections; the default), files (no symbols), or shallow (the project and
its top directories, from READMEs). agent index project add changes one
project's depth.

Usage:
  agent index root add DIR [flags]

Examples:
  agent index root add ~/dev
  agent index root add ~/src/vendor --depth shallow

Flags:
      --depth string   How deep its projects go: full, files or shallow (default "full")
  -h, --help           help for add
      --json           Print the root as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
